protocol.whitespace: one ASCII word space; trim per-line padding; preserve nonempty line breaks
protocol.aggregation: micro edit counts/reference counts; exact per eligible crop
protocol.failures: empty hypothesis on eligible rows; unavailable runs unscored

line_segmentation.transform: Horizontal regions: exact slicing. Sloping full-width regions: perspective rectify to original width and maximum side height, INTER_LINEAR/BORDER_REPLICATE
line_segmentation.unresolved_policy: No recognition regions and no automatic/full-crop fallback; retain crop ID and explicit error

preprocessing.recognizer_resize: Unmodified EasyOCR internal height/aspect-dependent width preprocessing

timing.preprocessing_ms: File read, SHA-256 check, image decode, RGB/grayscale conversion and line segmentation
timing.recognition_ms: Sum of synchronized wall times around each Reader.recognize call, including internal resize/transfer/forward/decode
timing.crop_total_ms: Wall time for preprocessing, synchronized recognition and result assembly
timing.excluded: Model initialization, warmups, preflight/integrity hashing, previews and result-file writes
timing.percentile: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q across successful heterogeneous crops, separately by set/field

identity.warmup_policy: First accepted-layout annotation crop per field (or first crop in automatic mode), repeated before measurements; unseen shapes can incur first-use costs

identity.warmup_policy: First accepted crop per field; discarded before measured pass

limitations: Human attestations recorded, not independently authenticated.
Declared hashes checked for correspondence; image bytes are not opened.
Exact overlap checks do not establish absence of near-duplicate leakage.
Crop-conditional accuracy, not end-to-end detection accuracy.
Latency covers successful saved crops only; hardware/warmup boundaries are run-specific.
Blank/absent and partial/illegible populations are counted but have no primary text score.
